children: Palm oil falls in Asian trading, weighed by declines in soybean oil on the Chicago Board of Trade as well as palm olein prices on the Dalian Commodity Exchange, says David Ng, a trader at Kuala Lumpur-based Iceberg X. However, he doesn't expect the price to keep trending lower, given the extreme weather conditions that could weigh on output. Ng pegs resistance at 5,000 ringgit a ton and support at 4,900 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for November delivery is down 33 ringgit at 4,940 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
